teaser: Canyon Ranch Austin is now welcoming guests on Lake Travis, a new restaurant-and-retail project is proposed on Hwy 71, and Spicewood Live opens its season Friday.

lead.headline: Canyon Ranch Austin opens its doors on Lake Travis in Spicewood
paragraphs: After years of construction, the Canyon Ranch wellness resort on the former Flying X Ranch began welcoming guests in late October. The property spreads across more than 600 acres in Spicewood, with roughly a mile and a half of Lake Travis shoreline.

The resort has 141 guest rooms and a spa of about 40,000 square feet with 40 treatment rooms, which CultureMap reports is the largest in Texas. Dining includes Estella, a signature restaurant whose menu is guided by the chef behind San Francisco's three-Michelin-star Californios, plus a cafe, a lounge and an outdoor grove for special dinners.
Stays are all-inclusive and start at $1,325 per person per night. A collection of 134 single-family homes is also planned on the property.

news.label: Development · Hwy 71
news.headline: SpiceQ mixed-use project proposed at 5600 Hwy 71
news.body: A state filing shows a planned $1.8 million development with restaurant and retail space on Hwy 71 in Spicewood. Construction is penciled in to start in January, though the project is still tentative.

news.label: Veterans Day · Nov 14
news.headline: Freedom Fest honors veterans at Iron Wolf Ranch
news.body: Iron Wolf Ranch & Distillery hosts a Veterans Day celebration on Saturday, November 14, with Nashville artists Taylor Hughes and Krystal King performing as part of the Lonestar Nights Texas Tour.

news.label: Holidays · Dec 4
news.headline: Marble Falls Light Up Parade returns December 4
news.body: Just up the road, downtown Marble Falls brings back its Light Up Parade on Friday, December 4, held alongside the Walkway of Lights season at Lakeside Park.
